chunks: And with this chain of narrators, it was said, Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Leprosy is a semi-curse; it will not be in us, nor in our descendants, nor in our Shia.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of leprosy in Shia theology according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Sifat al-Shia*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifying leprosy (*al-baras*) as a 'semi-curse' (*shibh al-la'nah*), distinguishing it from a full divine curse while still signifying spiritual or physical impurity. This hadith underscores the theological concept of *'ismah* (infallibility/purity) extending beyond the Prophet and Imams to their devoted followers, ensuring they are shielded from such afflictions as a mark of divine favor. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the physical and spiritual cleanliness associated with the Shia identity in early hadith literature.
